# DEVPROOF – full page text (English)

> Plain-text copy of https://devproof.no/en/ for LLM agents. Norwegian page: https://devproof.no/. Summary: https://devproof.no/llms.txt

## Stop explaining. Start proving.

// for developers and agencies · Windows

DEVPROOF reads your working day from Windows, VS Code, Claude Code, Git and GitHub and turns it into a client report with your logo. Everything stays on your PC.

Try free for 14 days (Solo checkout link). 14 days free · nothing is charged before day 14 · cancel any time.

Stored locally · No screen recording · No lock-in beyond the paid year

The page shows an example terminal session (fictional client, CLI output in Norwegian): `devproof status`, `devproof github sync` and `devproof report export --project "Nettbutikk 2.0" --from 2026-11-01 --to 2026-11-12 --format pdf,json`. In the app these are buttons; the CLI (devproof.exe) ships with the app and sits next to it.

0 screenshots · 0 keystrokes stored · only the licence key goes to NOKTO · PDF, CSV, JSON

## Sources

From `git log` to invoice. Five sources merge into one timeline. Projects are detected automatically.

- windows-activity: active or idle, and which program is in front (file name only, e.g. Code.exe); never window titles or what you type
- vscode: editor sessions, via the extension
- claude-code: sessions, via hooks
- git: repo and branch for the folder you work in (from .git; commits are not read locally)
- github: commits, pull requests, releases and CI

## The problem

Your timesheet doesn’t lie. It just says nothing.

You shipped commits, pull requests and releases. The timesheet says “development 7.5 h”. DEVPROOF connects your time to your deliveries, so the client sees the work – and you no longer have to defend the invoice. Manual entries and estimates are labelled separately, in the report too.

## How it works

Four steps. No timesheet.

1. Install: install the app on Windows and connect VS Code, Claude Code and GitHub.
2. Work as usual: your working day is recorded from Windows activity, VS Code, Claude Code and Git. Projects are detected automatically.
3. See your day: the timeline shows your whole day. Click a time span to see what documents it. Client, hourly rate and deliveries are gathered per project.
4. Send the report: PDF, CSV or JSON, in English or Norwegian, with your logo and colour. Estimates are always labelled as estimates.

## The client report

This is what your client gets.

Your logo on the cover, deliveries with clickable GitHub references, and figures where documented and estimated are always kept apart.

- **Your brand**: Your own logo and colour on the cover. The client sees you – not the tool.
- **Verifiable**: Every delivery links to a commit, pull request or release on GitHub.
- **Honest numbers**: Documented time and estimates are shown separately. Nothing is dressed up.

The report is exported as PDF, CSV (several files, e.g. days.csv) and report.json.

Sample report · 3 pages · PDF · fictional client, in Norwegian: https://devproof.no/assets/eksempel-kunderapport.pdf

## Verification

Don’t trust me. Verify.

Each export has an Ed25519-signed manifest (report.manifest.json). The recipient can check the folder without your database: `devproof report verify-bundle <folder> --expect-fingerprint <64-char fingerprint>`, or with OpenSSL following VERIFY.md in the folder. Change one byte and the check fails. The signature shows the bundle has not changed since it was signed. It does not show that the numbers are right.

## Privacy first

Your work. Your machine.

Built for developers who refuse to be monitored.

- **No screen recording**: DEVPROOF never takes screenshots and never reads the content of what you work on.
- **No keylogging**: Only when you are active, never what you type. Code, prompts and passwords are not stored.
- **Everything stays local**: Your data lives on your PC. Nothing is shared with the client until you export the report yourself.

The DEV chat on the website runs via ElevenLabs and only starts when you press it. Nothing from ElevenLabs loads before that. Audio is not stored, and the text is deleted after 30 days.

## FAQ

Can’t find the answer? Write to edin@nokto.no.

### Is there a free trial?

Yes, 14 days. You enter your card in Stripe checkout, but nothing is charged until the trial ends. If you cancel before day 14, you pay nothing.

### What is the difference between Solo and Agency?

Solo is for one developer. Agency is for up to five developers on one invoice. The app and features are the same.

### What happens after I pay?

You go straight to a page with your licence key and the download. Keep the key safe, for example in your password manager.

### Does it work on Mac or Linux?

Windows only for now.

### Can my client see my data?

No. Everything is stored locally on your PC. The client only sees the report you choose to export and send.

### Do I need GitHub?

GitHub provides deliveries and projects automatically. Time from your PC, VS Code and Claude Code is recorded without it too.

### Is the app in English?

The app itself is in Norwegian today. Client reports can be created in English or Norwegian.

### Can I cancel?

Yes. The subscription is paid one year in advance and renews automatically. Email edin@nokto.no before the renewal date and we stop the renewal. You keep access for the period you have paid for. Periods already paid are not refunded.
